description: Main FastAPI backend implementation for the investment teaser generator, including endpoints for health check, scraping, file upload, company confirmation, teaser generation, editing, and exporting as PDF.

classes.name: CompanyInfo
classes.description: Data model representing company information to be exchanged via API.

classes.name: ScrapeRequest
classes.description: Input model for the scraping endpoint, containing the URL to scrape.

classes.name: ScrapeResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the scraping results and status.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response model for file upload endpoint, listing uploaded files.

classes.name: UploadedFileInfo
classes.description: Information about an uploaded file, such as filename, size, and preview text.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyRequest
classes.description: Request model for confirming or editing company data.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyResponse
classes.description: Response message containing a session ID after confirming a company.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationRequest
classes.description: Input model for triggering teaser generation, including session and selected files.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationResponse
classes.description: Response containing generated teaser content and status.

classes.name: TeaserContent
classes.description: Model representing the teaser's title, content, company info, and metadata.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to check API health.

methods.name: on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes database tables upon application startup.

methods.name: on_shutdown()
methods.description: Placeholder for logic during shutdown (currently empty).

methods.name: scrape_company(req: ScrapeRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint to scrape company information from a provided URL.

methods.name: upload_files( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload and parse multiple files, returning summaries.

methods.name: confirm_company( req: ConfirmCompanyRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Allows user to confirm or edit extracted company info and start teaser workflow.

methods.name: generate_teaser( req: TeaserGenerationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Generates an investment teaser using AI based on company data and files.

methods.name: update_teaser( teaser_id: UUID, updated: TeaserContent = Body(..., description="Updated teaser content and title"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Allows editing of a previously generated teaser.

methods.name: export_teaser( teaser_id: UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Exports the teaser as a downloadable PDF and marks it as exported.

ctags.name: update_teaser
ctags.signature: ( teaser_id: UUID, updated: TeaserContent = Body(..., description="Updated teaser content and title"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
